configPrecedence: defaultConfig(env) — built-in defaults (CLAUDE_AGENT_MODEL / CLAUDE_AGENT_EFFORT / ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL consulted for default values)
configFromEnv(env) — LLM_SDK_* canonical names first, then CLAUDE_AGENT_* / ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / OTEL_* (provider-prefixed win)

configSchema.default: (unset; read by harness for span name, falls back to 'harness')
(unset; alias mirrored onto effort per layer)

hooks.name: afterRun
hooks.trigger: chat()/stream() after result ingested + store write, before run:end

hooks.name: afterToolCall
hooks.trigger: native PostToolUse bridge (non-error output) or wrapper when unbridged

hooks.name: beforeRun
hooks.trigger: after preflight(), before budget gate & dispatch; throw aborts

hooks.name: beforeToolCall
hooks.trigger: native PreToolUse + canUseTool (cached per toolUseId); {deny,reason} blocks, {updatedInput} rewrites

hooks.name: onBudgetExceeded
hooks.trigger: budget gate in block mode (before throw) and post-run reconcile 'exceeded'

hooks.name: onSessionEnd
hooks.trigger: native SessionEnd; harness.stop() when a session ran

hooks.name: onToolFailure
hooks.trigger: native PostToolUse (error output / handler error) or wrapper when unbridged

runtimeEnvVars.effect: auth mode 'cli-login'; prefer installed native binary (unless '0')
runtimeEnvVars.name: CLAUDE_AGENT_USE_CLI_LOGIN

consumedMessages: result (subtype, session_id, usage, total_cost_usd, num_turns, modelUsage, permission_denials)

enrichmentMethod: static regex class-member pass + manual source trace (no execution)
method: deterministic static AST & manifest analysis (zero SDK/network execution)
